messages.subject: lavaan tutorial in RMarkdown?
parts:
The lavaan tutorial is really helpful (http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/tutorial.pdf)

It's published in PDF which is handy for reading. But I also like toying with the examples in R, which means copy/paste/create line breaks/remove line breaks.

Could we also share the tutorial in an .Rmd format? This can be autogenerated from the .Rd files into a "vignettes" folder in Github. Or if the tutorial is created in .Rmd originally (it looks like it is) then why not just have a link to the .Rmd in the .pdf and vice versa?
